raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

FA2 is now only built by default when `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` includes SM8x or SM12x. On SM9x/SM10x/SM11x, FA2 is only an `8.0+PTX` fallback for configs FA3/FA4 don't cover, so Hopper/Blackwell-only builds skip it unless `VLLM_BUILD_FA2=1` is set (`VLLM_BUILD_FA2=0` always skips it).

- Release wheels and the Docker image are unchanged: their arch list includes SM8x, so FA2 is still built and shipped.
- SM12x keeps FA2 because it is the only FlashAttention path there (FA3 is SM90-only, FA4 doesn't support 12.x).
- On a `10.0`-only build this skips 76 compile units (~4.7 min wall at `-j64`) and a 310 MB `_vllm_fa2_C.abi3.so`.

When FA2 isn't built:
- `FlashAttentionBackend.supports_combination` rejects configs whose FA version resolves to nothing (e.g. head sizes FA4 can't handle, batch invariance on SM100), so backend selection falls through to FlashInfer/Triton.
- `FlashAttentionImpl` raises a clear `NotImplementedError` pointing at `VLLM_BUILD_FA2` when FLASH_ATTN is forced for a config that needs FA2 (e.g. ALiBi).
- `vllm.vllm_flash_attn` imports when only FA4 (CuteDSL) is present.
- `_vllm_fa2_C` becomes an empty CMake target and an optional extension in `setup.py`.

Depends on vllm-project/flash-attention#215 (respect a pre-set `FA2_ENABLED`). The FA pin here points at that PR's commit, which is `b273a02` (current pin) + that one change; it will be repointed to the merged commit.

Not a duplicate: no open vLLM or flash-attention PR makes FA2 optional. vllm-project/flash-attention#196 (native SM12x FA2 SASS) is complementary.

## Test plan

- CMake configure (against the FA branch) with `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` = `10.0` and `9.0 10.0` → FA2 skipped; `8.0 10.0`, `12.0`, and the release list `7.5 8.0 8.6 8.9 9.0 10.0 11.0 12.0` → FA2 built (`FA2_ARCHS: 8.0+PTX`); `VLLM_BUILD_FA2=1/0` overrides both ways. `ninja _vllm_fa2_C` is a no-op when skipped.
- `pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_attention_selector.py` on B300: 100 passed, 14 skipped. The two new tests fail without the backend change.
- E2E on B300 with the FA2 `.so` blocked from importing: Qwen3-0.6B and gemma-3-1b-it, both on the default backend (FlashInfer) and with `FLASH_ATTN` forced (FA4). All four ran and produced the expected greedy output (e.g. "The capital of France is" → " Paris. ...").
- `pre-commit run`: clean.

Default/release builds are unchanged, so no model evals were run.

AI assistance (Claude) was used to write this change; I've reviewed every line.

@@ -39,13 +39,30 @@ else()
   FetchContent_Declare(
           vllm-flash-attn
           GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/vllm-project/flash-attention.git
-          GIT_TAG b273a02621d3c94bc747df67204f591b67f38fae
+          GIT_TAG 0efe5cabaa1b243aeb0437447ef68ebc2db64c68
           GIT_PROGRESS TRUE
           # Don't share the vllm-flash-attn build between build types
           BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/vllm-flash-attn
   )
 endif()
 
+# FA2 is the only vllm-flash-attn backend on SM8x/SM12x. On SM9x/SM10x/SM11x it
+# is just a PTX fallback for configs FA3/FA4 don't cover, so only build it there
+# when requested via VLLM_BUILD_FA2=ON (set VLLM_BUILD_FA2=OFF to always skip).
+if (DEFINED ENV{VLLM_BUILD_FA2})
+  set(VLLM_BUILD_FA2 $ENV{VLLM_BUILD_FA2})
+endif()
+if (NOT DEFINED VLLM_BUILD_FA2)
+  set(VLLM_BUILD_FA2 OFF)
+  foreach(_ARCH ${CUDA_ARCHS})
+    if (_ARCH MATCHES "^(8|12)\\.")
+      set(VLLM_BUILD_FA2 ON)
+    endif()
+  endforeach()
+endif()
+set(FA2_ENABLED ${VLLM_BUILD_FA2})
+message(STATUS "Building vllm-flash-attn FA2: ${FA2_ENABLED}")
+
 # Make sure vllm-flash-attn install rules are nested under vllm/
 # ALL_COMPONENTS ensures the save/modify/restore runs exactly once regardless
 # of how many components are being installed, avoiding double-append of /vllm/.
@@ -57,6 +74,11 @@ install(CODE "set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX \"\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/vllm/\")" ALL_
 FetchContent_MakeAvailable(vllm-flash-attn)
 message(STATUS "vllm-flash-attn is available at ${vllm-flash-attn_SOURCE_DIR}")
 
+if (NOT TARGET _vllm_fa2_C)
+  # Empty target so setup.py can still request it
+  add_custom_target(_vllm_fa2_C)
+endif()
+
 # Restore the install prefix after FA's install rules
 install(CODE "set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX \"\${OLD_CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}\")" ALL_COMPONENTS)
 install(CODE "set(CMAKE_INSTALL_LOCAL_ONLY TRUE)" ALL_COMPONENTS)

     vLLM normalizes CUDA architectures on a per-source basis to optimize build times and wheel sizes. Global `+PTX` requests in `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` (e.g., `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="8.0+PTX"`) are ignored for general extension targets; vLLM generates PTX only for specific internal kernels that require it.
 
+    FlashAttention 2 is only built by default when `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` includes an SM8x or SM12x architecture. On Hopper/Blackwell-only builds it is skipped since FA3/FA4 are used there; set `VLLM_BUILD_FA2=1` to build it anyway (e.g. for ALiBi models, or head sizes FA4 does not support), or `VLLM_BUILD_FA2=0` to always skip it.
+
 !!! tip
     Building from source requires a lot of compilation. If you are building from source repeatedly, it's more efficient to cache the compilation results.
